d: A group of friends uncover an otherworldly object in a rural field, which they soon discover holds greater secrets than they could imagine.
Two scientists are selected to travel across the universe to the source of a distant transmission and potential life.
A family man struggling to hold it all together discovers a hidden parlor that offers a solution...sexbots.
In near-future California, high-school senior Aisha discovers a dark secret about herself. As she begins to wonder whether she's human, she goes from dreams of graduation to running for her life.

After a mysterious atmospheric event, a small group of people wake up to realize that their entire lives have been a lie. They are in fact aliens disguised as humans. Now they have to make a choice. Live amongst men, or try to find a way back home.
Justin Timberlake and Amanda Seyfried co-star in this sci-fi thriller set in a future world where aging stops at 25, and the only way for one man to stay alive is to steal more time.
A series of uncanny déjà vu events force a man to re-examine his tragic past, memory, instinct, and future.

Four friends find an object with special powers that belongs to two alien kids from the planet 62F. Now they must race to get it back to its rightful owners, but NASA are on their tail and they will stop at nothing to get their hands on it.

When a colossal tectonic shift causes the sea level to start rising, a microbiologist gathers the DNA of as many species as she can, while the military creates an "ark" in a desperate attempt to preserve life on Earth.
